coverage_details: All approved source rows, nulls and invalid entries remain in projections. Prefix exclusions and response attrition were retained in private/source_coverage.json; development response counts/values are not a learner input at this phase.
further_release_requires: Exact complete DevelopmentPredictionFreeze, matching code/data/approval digests, all six canonical classes and 288 predictions including failures; independent source/test review before any separate response release.
unexported_scope: Rep6, all known rep6 aliases, all other source groups/fields/windows and normalized-only rep2. Unexported portions of rep1-rep5 are not independent holdouts; unknown cross-file aliases must inherit development exposure if later identified.
limitations: This is a retrospective conditional mapping on the published, selected/processed cohort. The exact original export/filter/inpainting history is unresolved and may have used future observations. Neither the availability of earlier-frame features nor the original cohort is certified causally prefix-only. This limitation is not repaired by prohibiting new leakage in our own preprocessing.

All released groups have the same documented downshift. This experiment cannot identify a glucose dose-response or distinguish its biological effect from elapsed stimulus-relative time and unknown acquisition/batch history. Do not infer missing absolute clocks.

Normalized rep2 and other incompletely mapped cross-file entries are nonexported, not certified independent of these development groups. Retain unresolved alias/preparation/batch relations. If a later crosswalk identifies an alias of a released experiment, mark its biological component exposed to development rather than relabelling it unseen.

No external registry/HMAC infrastructure is provisioned by this document. Preserve the existing strong verifier and all its controls. A separate accountable custodian may approve this limited, non-authorizing development release using source replay, exact allowlists and retained operational records. Do not fabricate production keys/signatures or claim encryption, OS isolation, immutable external chronology or adversarial security.
